prompts.prompt: An elderly man holding a black umbrella on a rain-soaked city street at night, neon reflections on wet asphalt, 35mm film grain, shallow depth of field, cinematic
prompts.prompt_zh: 夜晚雨后的城市街道上，一位老人撑着黑伞，霓虹灯映在湿漉漉的柏油路上，35mm 胶片颗粒，浅景深，电影感

prompts.prompt: A minimalist glass perfume bottle with a gold cap on a pure white background, soft studio lighting, subtle reflection, product photography
prompts.prompt_zh: 纯白背景上一只极简风格的玻璃香水瓶，金色瓶盖，柔和的棚拍灯光，淡淡的倒影，产品摄影

prompts.prompt: A café chalkboard sign that reads "OPEN 7AM – 9PM · Fresh Bagels" in neat white chalk lettering, wooden frame, warm light
prompts.prompt_zh: 一块咖啡馆黑板招牌，用整齐的白色粉笔字写着 "OPEN 7AM – 9PM · Fresh Bagels"，木质边框，暖光

prompts.prompt: 一副红纸金字的春联，上面写着“福满人间”四个楷体大字，挂在木门旁，喜庆，高清
prompts.prompt_zh: 一副红纸金字的春联，上面写着“福满人间”四个楷体大字，挂在木门旁，喜庆，高清

prompts.prompt: Three animals — a fox, a raccoon and an owl — playing poker at a round wooden table, each with a distinct expression and prop (monocle, cigar, teacup), warm lamp light, detailed
prompts.prompt_zh: 三只动物——狐狸、浣熊和猫头鹰——围坐在圆木桌旁打扑克，各有不同的表情和道具（单片眼镜、雪茄、茶杯），暖色台灯光，细节丰富

prompts.prompt: A small mountain town in a valley at dawn, thin morning mist, Studio Ghibli style illustration, soft colors, hand-painted look
prompts.prompt_zh: 黎明时分山谷中的小镇，薄薄的晨雾，吉卜力工作室风格插画，柔和的色彩，手绘质感
